items.text: Nvidia previewed TensorRT Model Connect, converting supported Hugging Face models into end-to-end TensorRT inference with two commands.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 TensorRT Model Connect 预览版，只需两条命令即可将受支持的 Hugging Face 模型转为端到端 TensorRT 推理。

items.text: Pika detailed Soundtrack’s video-to-audio model, reporting strong temporal alignment and warm self-hosted generation averaging 0.617 seconds per video second.
items.text_zh: Pika 详解 Soundtrack 视频转音频模型，称其时间对齐表现突出，热启动自托管生成平均每秒视频耗时 0.617 秒。

items.text: Claude can now send Gmail messages and manage Google Drive files, with users retaining approval control over actions.
items.text_zh: Claude 现可发送 Gmail 邮件并管理 Google Drive 文件，具体操作仍由用户确认和控制。

items.text: Microsoft’s MAI-Image-2.6 Preview reached third place in Arena’s single-image editing leaderboard with 1,420 points.
items.text_zh: 微软 MAI-Image-2.6 预览版以 1420 分升至 Arena 单图编辑排行榜第三名。

items.text: HeyGen introduced Brand Kits for preset fonts, logos, colors and pronunciation guidance across avatar-generated content.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 推出 Brand Kits，可为数字人生成内容预设字体、标志、品牌颜色及产品名称发音规则。

items.text: Perplexity’s Computer agent now accepts tasks through email when users send, forward or copy messages to computer@perplexity.com.
items.text_zh: 用户现在可将邮件发送、转发或抄送至 computer@perplexity.com，直接通过邮件向 Perplexity Computer 智能体分派任务。

items.text: Vercel launched a $1 million challenge inviting researchers to escape its Firecracker-based Sandbox or break isolation boundaries.
items.text_zh: Vercel 发起百万美元挑战，邀请安全研究人员尝试逃逸其基于 Firecracker 的 Sandbox 或突破隔离边界。

items.text: Hugging Face’s model repository surpassed three million models, marking another milestone for its open AI ecosystem.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 模型仓库突破 300 万个模型，成为其开放人工智能生态的又一里程碑。

items.text: Modular released the Mojo programming language as open source.
items.text_zh: Modular 将 Mojo 编程语言正式开源。

items.text: Mozilla updated Firefox Smart Window, an integrated AI assistant designed to maintain browsing context as users move between tasks.
items.text_zh: Mozilla 更新 Firefox Smart Window，这款内置人工智能助手可在用户切换任务时持续理解浏览上下文。

items.text: Synthefy raised $6.5 million to develop models trained specifically on numerical data rather than primarily on text.
items.text_zh: Synthefy 融资 650 万美元，用于开发主要以数值数据而非文本训练的模型。

items.text: Hypercubic raised $5.3 million for AI agents that map, understand and rewrite legacy COBOL applications.
items.text_zh: Hypercubic 融资 530 万美元，开发能够梳理、理解并重写传统 COBOL 应用的人工智能智能体。

items.text: Warp launched an out-of-the-box software factory intended to coordinate AI agents across application development workflows.
items.text_zh: Warp 推出开箱即用的软件工厂，用于在应用开发流程中协调多个人工智能智能体。

items.text: Stability AI introduced a plugin that brings Stable Audio 3.0 generation directly into music-production workflows.
items.text_zh: Stability AI 推出新插件，将 Stable Audio 3.0 生成功能直接带入音乐制作工作流。
